name: Nyotai Inkan ~Utsurikawaru Chijokuteki Koukishin~
original_name: 女体淫換 ～移り変わる恥辱的好奇心～
source:
While on a field trip to a museum, the protagonist's 4-person group accidently breaks a cursed jar due to some trivial dispute. And the following day, it seems that their minds and bodies are swapped because of the curse. Thus begins their struggle to dispel the curse in order to change back to normal.

[Translated from [url=http://www.noirsoft.co.jp/irekawari/story.html]Offical Site[/url]]
translation:
主角四人在参观博物馆时，因一些琐事发生争执，不小心打碎了魔罐。而第二天，他们的思想和身体似乎都因为诅咒而互换了。于是，他们开始了消除诅咒、恢复正常的斗争。

[译自[url=http://www.noirsoft.co.jp/irekawari/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
